## What and why

Release prep for fe **v0.4.0**: the redesign (PILOT-368, review PASS in OlegShevtsov1/1_mvp_pilot_be#147) plus everything
merged into `develop` since v0.3.1. That includes PILOT-273 (#51), which v0.3.1 left out, PILOT-393 (no private
address in the public `SENTRY_DSN`) and PILOT-419 (privacy and terms pages).

- Card: <card URL> (PILOT-467, the release's own card, decision 91).
- The change is `CHANGELOG.md` only. The `[Unreleased]` entries move into `## [0.4.0] - 2026-10-30` without their
  empty `### Deprecated` and `### Removed` headings, and a fresh `[Unreleased]` with the six empty categories takes
  their place. Everything from `## [0.3.1]` down is unchanged.
- The section's `Minimum backend version: v0.3.0` equals `deploy/min-be-version` (`v0.3.0`). Nothing differs, so
  `deploy/min-be-version` is not touched.
- Base: `develop` at `929dc43a6d2ae0c0bb8dbd14781cb73226382633`.

## Definition of Done of the task

- [x] `CHANGELOG.md` has `## [0.4.0] - 2026-10-30` with every former `[Unreleased]` entry, verbatim and in order, and
      no empty headings.
- [x] A fresh `## [Unreleased]` with `Minimum backend version: v0.3.0` and the six empty categories.
- [x] `scripts/next-version.sh origin/develop` prints `0.4.0`.
- [x] The minimum backend line equals `deploy/min-be-version` (`v0.3.0`).
- [x] Every squash commit since v0.3.1 has exactly one `Type:` line.
- [x] No file other than `CHANGELOG.md` changed.
- [ ] After merge: A0–A6 below, through `run=PILOT467`.

## How it was checked

- `scripts/next-version.sh origin/develop` → `0.4.0` (exit 0).
- `scripts/release-notes.sh v0.4.0` → `Minimum backend version: v0.3.0`, then `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Fixed`
  and `### Security` with all 20 entries.
- `scripts/release-notes.sh Unreleased` → the minimum line and the six empty headings.
- `diff <(awk '/^## \[0.3.1\]/{f=1} f' CHANGELOG.md) <(git show origin/develop:CHANGELOG.md | awk '/^## \[0.3.1\]/{f=1} f')`
  → no difference.
- `npx prettier --check CHANGELOG.md` → clean.
- `npx vitest run tests/release-notes.test.ts tests/git-branching.test.ts tests/changelog-check.test.ts tests/release-check.test.ts tests/pr-conventions.test.ts tests/release-workflows.test.ts`
  → 6 files, 95 tests passed.
- `scripts/pr-conventions.sh` accepts this PR (title `PILOT-467: Release 0.4.0 changelog`, base `develop`, this body)
  and the A2 release PR (title `PILOT-467: Release v0.4.0`, head `develop`, base `main`, the A2 body).

## After merge (operator)

Run: `archon workflow run post-merge --cwd /home/operator/projects/mvp/1_mvp_pilot_fe --no-worktree "run=PILOT467 pr=<this PR URL>"`.

Any Expected not met: stop, run no later step, and pause on a gate with the evidence (command, output, run URL).
🔒 marks a GitHub or prod write.

Rollback: dev, a revert PR of this change (`bin/dev-rollback`); prod,
`GH_TOKEN="$(gh auth token -u OlegShevtsov1)" gh workflow run kamal-manage.yml -R OlegShevtsov1/1_mvp_pilot_fe --ref main -f action=rollback -f version=prod-previous -f confirm=ROLLBACK-prod`
(back to `prod-sha-9574e04…`, fe v0.3.1). A published tag is never moved or deleted.

Skipped on purpose (proven in v0.2.0): the test dev deploy from the mirror and the wrong-source_sha negative.

Release notes are always read from the CHANGELOG at D, never from the operator checkout.
